subject: Re: Trial evaluation & success criteria for Highland Diagnostics
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Keller <tom.keller@highlanddx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + next steps (trial scope)

Hi Tom,

Thanks again for the call today — great context on your imaging ingestion pipeline and where latency spikes are causing backlogs during batch reviews. Quick recap and a proposed path for a focused evaluation/trial: 

Key goals you mentioned:
- Reduce inference latency for on-demand reads to under 220ms median end-to-end
- Keep per-device cost neutral vs current GPU-hosted baseline (target: <= $0.12 inference-min)
- Maintain model output fidelity (no more than 3% degradation on key label set)

Proposed trial (high level):
1) 2-week pilot with a sample of 5k representative requests (mix of short/long sequences)
2) Weekly check-ins (30 min) with results snapshot and tuning recommendations
3) Final readout with metrics, cost breakdown, and recommended configuration for production rollout

Owners:
- Redwood AE / trial owner: me (Rishi) — coordination, scheduling, acceptance criteria
- Solutions/Bench: Connor — environment setup, model tuning, runbook
- Customer success: Marissa — onboarding, data ingestion checklist, SLO/template docs

Attachments: trial-plan-template.xlsx (draft schedule & metric table), redwood-sla-summary.pdf (SLOs we typically observe)

Can you confirm the sample size and whether we can get a small snapshot of your anonymized test dataset (5–10 example payloads) before kickoff? Also suggested kickoff windows: Aug 6 or Aug 10.

If that looks right I'll circulate a calendar invite with the kickoff agenda and a short prep checklist.

Thanks,
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Tom Keller <tom.keller@highlanddx.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps (trial scope)

Rishi — thanks for the quick write-up. This maps to what we discussed. A few clarifications: 

- The 5k request sample looks fine; we'll likely subset from last month's review queue. Expect a mix roughly 70% short reads / 30% long.
- Latency target: 220ms median is reasonable for our UX. For SLA calculations, we care about p95 as well — can we include that as an explicit metric?
- Cost: our $0.12 target is per inference-minute equivalent; we'll need the cost cadence broken down by token vs overhead.

We can share anonymized payloads — I'll have Aisha drop them into the secure S3 bucket tonight (Aisha is on the cc). Aug 10 works better for our engineering team for kickoff.

Also can you call out what redwood logs we can access during the trial for traceability (request IDs, model version, latency traces)?

Appreciate it,
Tom
CTO | Highland Diagnostics
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Keller <tom.keller@highlanddx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Trial plan + metrics table (includes p95) — action items before kickoff

Tom,

Thanks — great feedback. I've updated the plan to include p95 and a cost breakdown by token vs fixed overhead. Below is the trial milestone schedule and acceptance criteria we propose. I've kept this high-level so we can align during the kickoff.

Trial timeline (proposed):
- Prep week (Aug 10): data snapshot ingestion, access to S3, sample payload validation, baseline run for current config
- Run week (Aug 11–Aug 17): 5k requests run across your sample distro, parallel runs of two config variants (low-latency and cost-optimized)
- Analysis & tuning (Aug 18–Aug 19): consolidate metrics, quick tuning loop from Connor
- Final readout (Aug 20): 45-minute readout with exec summary and recommended config

Success metrics (acceptance):
- Latency: median <= 220ms and p95 <= 500ms on the low-latency config
- Cost: cost-per-inference-minute <= $0.12 on cost-optimized variant (or documented trade-off)
- Quality: model label agreement with your holdout >= 97% (i.e., <= 3% degradation)

Ownership:
- Pickup & data access: Highland (Tom / Aisha) — provide 5–10 example payloads and S3 access by Aug 10 EOD
- Environment & runs: Connor (solutions) — create trial stack, run variants, surface logs
- Onboarding & post-trial playbook: Marissa (CS) — ensure runbook + ops checklist delivered at readout
- Acceptance signoff: Tom (Highland) + Rishi

Logs & visibility: Connor will enable request-level traces and provide a shared dashboard with: request_id, model_version, start_time, end_time, latency_ms, token_count, and error_rate. We will also share cost estimates per-run and a breakout of fixed vs per-token components.

Prep asks before Aug 10 kickoff:
- Highland: S3 path + example payloads (anonymized)
- Highland: nominal traffic mix (short/long %)
- Redwood: share trial-run calendar invite and pre-kickoff checklist (I'll send this after you confirm Aug 10)

I've attached the trial-plan-template.xlsx with the milestone table and the metric column definitions.

If Aug 10 is confirmed I'll send the invite for Aug 10 10:00–10:30 PT as the kickoff.

Best,
Rishi
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Keller <tom.keller@highlanddx.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial plan + metrics table (includes p95) — action items before kickoff

Taom/Tom (typo: Tom) — adding a few CS-specific items so the trial runs smoothly: 

- Ingestion checklist: does the sample include the same pre-processing steps you run in prod (normalization, anonymization)? If not, please document differences.
- Retention & access: confirm any data retention constraints — Redwood will limit logs to trial retention policy by default (14 days) unless you request otherwise.
- Success readout: we'll prepare a 'runbook to production' draft if acceptance criteria are met; that doc will include rollout steps and estimated infra cost in your account.

Connor — when you spin up the trial stack please ensure trace IDs align with Highland's request_id field (we'll sync format in the kickoff).

Tom — Aug 10 10:00–10:30 PT works for us. I'll include a short agenda and the pre-kickoff checklist in the invite.

Thanks,
Marissa
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
